$comment: Free agency screen strings (O6.6.1, item 7). Every user-facing string comes from here by id with named slots.

strings.fa.none: Free agency is not open to you in this job.
strings.fa.phase.before_window: Before the negotiating window. Talking to other clubs' players now is tampering.
strings.fa.phase.negotiating_window: Negotiating window: your front office may talk to agents. Nothing can be signed until the league year opens.
strings.fa.phase.open: The league year is open. Contracts can be signed.
strings.fa.firstWave: First wave: the top players are going fast.
strings.fa.authority.decide: You have final say on contracts. Your offers are the club's offers.
strings.fa.authority.delegated: Your personnel man is handling contracts for you. The results are still yours.
strings.fa.authority.advise.general_manager: The general manager has final say on contracts. Your offers go to him as requests.
strings.fa.authority.advise.owner: The owner has final say on contracts. Your offers go to him as requests.
strings.fa.authority.advise.executive: The club executive has final say on contracts. Your offers go to him as requests.
strings.fa.authority.advise.head_coach: Contracts are not yours to decide in this job. Your offers go as requests.
strings.fa.market.title: Free agent list
strings.fa.rights.offerSheet: Offer sheet: his old club may match
strings.fa.interest.unknown: What he wants is not known
strings.fa.call.title: Call him
strings.fa.call.illegal: Calling now breaks the contact rules: {reason}. It will be logged.
strings.fa.call.blocked: His agent will not put the call through until the money is close.
strings.fa.call.windowCall: This uses one of your window calls.
strings.fa.own.title: Your expiring players
strings.fa.readOnly: You can look but not act from this seat.
